code:
const wallets = ["0xAb12...", "0xCd34...", "0xEf56..."];

console.log(wallets[0]);     // "0xAb12..." -- indexes start at 0
console.log(wallets.length); // 3

wallets.push("0x9988...");   // adds to the end
console.log(wallets.length); // 4
caption: The first element is always index 0, not 1.
Dot notation is the common style; brackets are needed for a dynamic property name.
An object containing an array of objects — the shape most blockchain data arrives in.
Forgiving, but a typo in a property name fails silently instead of loudly.
